description: This file defines and manages Kilocode model configurations, including static catalog, model discovery via API, and model definition structures. It includes functions for parsing model data, handling API responses, and exporting model definitions.

methods.name: toPricePerMillion
methods.description: Converts a string token price to a numeric value per million tokens.

methods.name: parseModality
methods.description: Determines input modalities ('text' and/or 'image') based on model architecture input_modalities.

methods.name: parseReasoning
methods.description: Checks if the model supports reasoning based on supported_parameters.

methods.name: toModelDefinition
methods.description: Converts a GatewayModelEntry object into a ModelDefinitionConfig object.

methods.name: buildStaticCatalog
methods.description: Builds a static catalog of model definitions from predefined constants.

methods.name: discoverKilocodeModels
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and discovers available Kilocode models from API or returns static catalog in test environments.

methods.name: buildKilocodeModelDefinition
methods.description: Creates a default Kilocode model definition object.
